name: Cards On The Table
description:
About This Game

Poker, But Not As You Know It

Cards on the Table is a roguelike poker deckbuilder where there is no bluffing - every hand is a showdown! Each suit has unique powers that can help you construct your hand, tear down your opponent, or tip the balance of chips to your advantage. As well as the standard suits, you'll find new suits such as Voids, which can wipe the rank and suit from cards opposite, or Plants, which spread to neighboring cards to make easy flushes. As you progress through successive runs you will unlock many more!

Customize Your Deck

Improve cards by adding to their ranks, repaint them to try out new suits, or slice up cards and stitch them together to create powerful combos!

Find Powerful Cards and Relics

Pick up new cards, relics and even tarot as you progress through your run, enabling new synergies and combos to lock in your advantage.

Key Features

  • Poker where every hand is a showdown

  • Add cards to your deck as you work your way through the matches

  • Each suit has a unique power that affects yours or your opponent's hand

  • Huge variation in playstyles as you pick four starter suits at the beginning of each run

  • Unlock new starter suits to for new tactical possibilities

  • Poker hands that go beyond the usual five cards - Nine card straights! Seven of a kind!

  • Stitch cards together to synergize their powers

  • Powerful relics that change the way you play

  • A broad cast of kooky characters
short_desc: Climb the ranks at the wizard poker tournament with an enchanted deck of cards where every suit has powers. Put down huge poker hands, create absurd combos, and fuse, repaint and stitch your cards together, as you stack your opponents and prepare to bring down the house!
